cohort: The study included 200 children (155 boys, 45 girls) with a mean age of 4.6 ± 1.8 years, diagnosed with ASD at Hawler Psychiatric Hospital in Erbil city.
finding: Severe autism symptoms were significantly associated with older child age, younger age at first assessment, delayed speech, parental consanguinity, paternal age over 40, lower paternal education, and lower socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was reported as the most common mode of delivery among the participants.
